heading.title: Of Grant of Probate and Letters of Administration

article.title: Right to administration of representative of deceased residuary legatee.
article.content:
233Right to administration of representative of deceased residuary legatee.

Section 233  ·  Part IX · Chapter I  ·  page 71 of the Act
When a residuary legatee who has a beneficial interest survives the testator, but dies before the estate has been fully administered, his representative has the same right to administration with the will annexed as such residuary legatee.
